title: Investigator
description: An investigator entity as published in PublicGame.investigators/otherInvestigators/killedInvestigators (Arkham.Investigator.Types.InvestigatorAttrs, merged with per-connection HasGame data such as connectedLocations). Deck/hand/discard card-union payloads, ability/action bookkeeping, campaign log, and slot layout remain intentionally broad in this contract slice; only the top-level field set, ids, and scalar stats are asserted exactly.

actionsPerformed.description: Actions performed this round, keyed by action type. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

actionsTaken.description: Actions taken this turn. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

additionalActions.description: Additional-action grants currently available. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

art.description: The card art/back code, usually equal to cardCode.

assets.description: AssetId (UUID) values owned/controlled by this investigator.

assignedHealthHeal.description: Pending health-heal assignments. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

assignedSanityHeal.description: Pending sanity-heal assignments. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

beganRoundAt.description: Maybe LocationId (UUID) recorded at the start of this investigator's turn.

bondedCards.description: Bonded cards attached to this investigator. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

cardsUnderneath.description: Cards physically stacked underneath this investigator. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

connectedLocations.description: Computed at snapshot time: LocationId (UUID) values currently reachable from this investigator.

deck.description: Remaining deck cards. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

deckBuildingAdjustments.description: Deckbuilding option adjustments. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

decks.description: Named side decks (e.g. bonded/spectral decks). Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

discard.description: Discarded cards. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

discarding.description: In-progress discard state, if any. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

discover.description: In-progress clue-discovery state, if any. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

drawing.description: In-progress card-draw state, if any. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

drawnCards.description: Cards drawn so far this draw step. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

engagedEnemies.description: EnemyId (UUID) values currently engaged with this investigator.

events.description: EventId (UUID) values owned/controlled by this investigator.

excludeFromMulligan.description: Cards excluded from the opening mulligan. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

form.description: The investigator's current alternate-form state, if any (e.g. transformation cards). Broad tagged union beyond its tag, out of scope for this contract slice.

hand.description: Cards currently in hand. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

keys.description: Arkham keys held by this investigator. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

log.description: Per-investigator recorded campaign log entries. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

modifiers.description: Active modifiers targeting this investigator. Broad and additive, out of scope for this contract slice.

movement.description: InvestigatorAttrs.investigatorMovement (Maybe Movement): the in-progress move this investigator is currently mid-resolving, if any.

mutated.description: An overriding mutated card code, if any.

previousLocation.description: Maybe LocationId (UUID) this investigator moved from most recently.

scarletKeys.description: ScarletKeyId (card code) values held by this investigator.

seals.description: Scarlet Keys campaign seals placed on this investigator. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

search.description: In-progress search state, if any. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

settings.description: Per-investigator UI/rules settings (global and per-card overrides). Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

sideDeck.description: A named side deck reference, if any. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

skills.description: SkillId (UUID) values granted to this investigator.

slots.description: The investigator's asset slot layout and current occupants, encoded as an array of [slotType, slots] pairs. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

startsWith.description: Cards this investigator's deck must start with. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

startsWithInHand.description: Cards that start in this investigator's opening hand. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

supplies.description: Campaign supply cards. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

taboo.description: The applied taboo list id, if any.

tokens.description: A Token-keyed multiset (e.g. resources, clues), encoded as an array of [tokenName, count] pairs.

traits.description: An open, additive string set of card traits (e.g. Agency, Detective). Not a closed enum.

treacheries.description: TreacheryId (UUID) values attached to this investigator.

usedAbilities.description: Abilities used and their remaining-use bookkeeping. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

usedAdditionalActions.description: Additional-action grants already consumed. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.
